placements.title: Rehearsal is what makes a rollback real
placements.frame: What has to happen before a rollback can be counted as actually held — how often is it rehearsed, and who answers for it?
placements.why: The supplied graph structure and EXISTING STRATA are both empty, so nothing existing can hold this. The grain test admits it: 'a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have' names a standing subject — rehearsed recovery capability — that future envelopes can keep feeding, not a one-time measurement. The specific cadence (monthly) and owner (Quinton Fairweather) are position-grain and stay in AtlasRollbackRehearsalCommitment, which is the support this leaf rests on. Minted standalone because no hub exists to hold it.
